title: Safety at Scale: A Comprehensive Survey of Large Model and Agent Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing existing studies (e.g., character-level adversarial attacks) that expose and evaluate how generative models default to cultural stereotypes when processing manipulated text prompts.
Surveying safety evaluation benchmarks, frameworks, and datasets (such as Ethical-Lens and human-attribute datasets) designed to assess demographic stereotypes and fairness in AI-generated content.
